papers.title: Geometrical feature analysis of Co-Cr-Mo single tracks after selective laser melting processing
papers.abstract: Purpose – Therefore, the purpose of this study is to understand the relationships between the processing parameters and the geometric form of the produced single tracks, in order to control dimensional quality in future experimentations. The quality of the deposited single track and layer is of prime importance in the selective laser melting (SLM) process, as it affects the product quality in terms of dimensional precision and product performance. Design/methodology/approach – In this paper, a vertical milling machining center equipped with an Ytterbium-fiber laser was used in the SLM experimentation to form single cobalt-chromium-molybdenum (CoCrMo) tracks. The different geometric features and the influence of the scanning parameters on these morphologic characteristics were studied statistically by means of ANOVA. Findings – Evidently, track height (h1) inaccuracy reduced in layer thicknesses between 100 and 200 μm. The re-melt depth (h2) was determined by the energy parameters, with laser power of 325-350 W and scanning speed (SS) of 66.6-83.3 mm/s being the most favorable parameters to obtain the required anchoring. Moreover, a contact angle of 117° was proposed as optimal, as it permitted an adequate overlapping region and a full densification, and, finally, an SS of 50 mm/s and a layer thickness of 250 were suggested for its development. Originality/value – The comprehension of the phenomena inherent to the process is related to the single track geometrical characteristics, which allow the definition of an optimal value for each factor for a further proposal of processing conditions that can finally derive a higher precision, wetting, density and mechanical properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解SLM工艺参数对单道几何特征的影响，以控制尺寸精度
summary_zh.method: 用ANOVA统计研究CoCrMo单道几何特征与扫描参数的关系
summary_zh.result: 确定了最佳层厚、激光功率、扫描速度和接触角参数
summary_zh.validation: 仅统计ANOVA分析，无机械测试或生物验证

summary_en.motivation: To understand the relationship between process parameters and single track geometry in SLM for better dimensional control.
summary_en.method: Statistical analysis (ANOVA) was applied to investigate the influence of scanning parameters on geometric features of single CoCrMo tracks.
summary_en.result: Optimal ranges for layer thickness, laser power, scan speed, and contact angle were identified for improved track geometry.
summary_en.validation: No mechanical testing or biological validation was performed; validation is limited to statistical analysis of geometric features.

papers.title: Technological Limitations of Selective Laser Melting Method
papers.abstract: The method of selective laser melting (further SLM) has big prospects from the point of view of achievement of a difficult form of details with high precision and quality of a surface, however SLM has also a number of technological restrictions from the point of view of achievement of a difficult form of details. In this work technological capabilities of production of figurine details from a heat resisting cobalt alloy are investigated by method of selective laser melting, technological restrictions of a method and way of their overcoming are shown.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论选择性激光熔化的一般技术限制，未涉及生物医学植入物或应力遮挡问题。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no mechanical testing (fatigue or static), no surface roughness or osseointegration reporting.

summary_en.motivation: Investigate technological limitations of selective laser melting for producing complex-shaped parts.

summary_en.result: Identified technological restrictions of SLM and proposed ways to overcome them.

papers.title: Microstructural and Mechanical Properties of Selective Laser Melted Al 4047
papers.abstract: Selective laser melting (SLM) has been recognized as a pertinent process for manufacturing of complex geometries. Al 4047 has been manufactured in this study with different processing parameters of the SLM process to obtain the optimal parameters suitable for required applications, as well as to determine the effect of these parameters and post-processing heat treatment on mechanical properties. A unique Al-Si eutectic microstructure is obtained with Al dendrites growing in the scanning direction. Mechanical properties of the SLM manufactured Al 4047 are at par with those of conventionally manufactured alloy. These properties can be varied by changing the SLM process parameters which can help controlling the process cost depending upon required mechanical properties.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Al 4047铝合金的SLM工艺，与生物医学植入物或骨科应用无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure design for stress shielding, no osseointegration or surface roughness analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM工艺参数以获得Al 4047的最佳力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变SLM工艺参数和热处理，研究其对微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: SLM制造的Al 4047力学性能与传统制造相当，且可通过参数调节。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试力学性能并与传统制造对比。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize SLM process parameters for Al 4047 to achieve desired mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Varied SLM parameters and post-processing heat treatment to investigate effects on microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: SLM-manufactured Al 4047 exhibits mechanical properties comparable to those of conventionally manufactured alloy, with tunability via process parameters.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing and microstructural characterization.
